text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“—My first dream of the new year... was a 
dream about Maruzen-san!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Since I performed just like Maruzen-san, I 
will amazingly be chosen as the 'Best 
Junior Umamusume', just like Maruzen-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And training together, I advanced to the 
Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...That dream again, huh. ...Hm-mm.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Could it have been a prophetic dream...? 
What if I really become the Umamusume of 
the Year...?!"
(Knock knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Chiyono O-san. And I am 
terribly sorry... I was unable to come 
watch the Asahi Hai FS the other day...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ardan-san?! Happy New Year! Are you 
feeling all better now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I apologize for causing you concern. 
From today on, I am fully prepared to face 
my training with earnest dedication.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! What a relief...! There's so much I 
want to talk to you about—
"Get ready! Ready, set, go!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? M-My phone is... I'm so sorry, of 
all the times for it to go off!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Onii-chan! I'll call you back later, 
so—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“—And that concludes the candidates for 
this year's URA Awards. The winner of Best 
Junior Umamusume set a record in a 1,600m 
Junior-class race...”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's an amazing Umamusume with 127 votes. 
...It wasn't Sakura Chiyo no O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The feedback for me was... "Reasonably 
strong. However, she lacks that certain 
sparkle, that extra special something 
beyond that." ...Apparently.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Mmm, is that so...? So it's a no, then...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Still, there was someone who truly 
appreciated your work. Right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm extremely grateful for that. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though the fact that I am 
"ordinary" has been thrust in my face once 
again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Normal?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, my efforts have always been 
acknowledged. On a 5-point report card, 
the numbers I usually saw were 3s and 4s. 
A 'not bad' Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Still... it's just 'not bad.' I can't 
surpass imagination. I can't break the 
mold. For better or worse... I'm just 
ordinary."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I guess I realized... that I'll never be 
an overwhelming genius like the Umamusume 
who got over 120 votes this time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Chiyono O-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“B-But even if I'm just an ordinary 
Umamusume, I'm not giving up on my dream!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If my opponent is a genius who draws first 
prize on their first try, then I will 
simply draw a hundred tickets before they 
do.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Then, before that genius can pull that one 
ticket, we might just win first prize!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Ardan-san. I'll be taking my 
leave here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the Derby, all an ordinary 
girl like me can do is never give up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Chiyono O is just like me. Someone 
striving to overturn who 'they' are."
(RATTLE-CLATTER!!)

New Year's Day. While I was planning the 
training regimen for next week, Sakura 
Chiyono O burst into the room.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, um! Could we move up our schedule 
and start training earlier!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to tell me what I lack right 
now... what I need!"
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's the ability to read how a race 
will unfold.

Instead, let's explore a whole new side of 
you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Understood! Then let's get 
ready right away and head out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Observational training, of course! Let's 
see... the next high-profile race is—"

"...And thus, preparations were completed 
by Sakura Chiyono O—"

I was supposed to watch the races at Kyoto 
Racecourse with Sakura Chiyo no O.
choice_data_list: What a frightening amount of drive...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That just shows how full of motivation you 
are!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-san, focus on the race 
too!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross is surging from the back! 
She's storming up all at once with 
unbelievable speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh~, so this is what Chaser style is 
like...! Aha~... I see, I see."

And so, I continued to watch the races 
with Sakura Chiyono O for a while.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Rest, you say?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll use the lint roller here. That 
should be fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then... oof!

And Sakura Chiyono O laid down on the 
heated rug laid out in the Trainer's room.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's have a strategy meeting for 
our next race~!
choice_data_list:
That's why I'm telling you to rest for 
now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm currently resting~ This is just me 
rolling around in the Trainer's Room, 
making small talk with you, Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Hurry!! Hurry up and tell me 
about the next race!

Sakura Chiyo no O had suddenly started 
nitpicking everything with absurd logic, 
and we spent some time like that in the 
trainer's room.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Unlocking a whole new side of yourself...! 
In other words, that means—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh, clever one. To think you'd reach out 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
First, a test. Say it. ..."Please make me 
a bad girl."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... Make me into... a bad girl...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyah!? Trainer-san!?

I ended up having to hurriedly stop Sakura 
Chiyono O as she nearly headed down the 
wrong path.
